useIndex.description:
If True, then the indices of `targetOutput`, `modelOutput`, and `context` are used for score
calculation.

batchSize.description:
If the provided data does not fit in memory, then use this value as batch size to iterate through and compute incremental
metrics on batches of data.

probaThreshold.description:
`probaThreshold` is a `double` value used to convert the predicted probabilities to class
labels for Recall Score calculation. `probaThreshold` defaults to 0.5 if no value is provided with the predicted
probabilities as input

title:
The {@link MlRecallMetric} computes the proportion of positive label values that were predicted correctly. Expressed
as a formula:
```
recall = true_positives / (true_positives + false_negatives)
```
This metric only works for binary classification. If there are no true positive and false negative predictions,
this metric returns 0. The `modelOutput` can either be a single-dimensional with binary (i.e. 0 and 1) data
or two-dimensional with predicted probabilities for class '0' and '1'. Column '1' will be used for scoring.
The `targetOutput` is expected to be single-dimensional with binary (i.e. 0 and 1) data.
This metric supports `sampleWeights` as `context`. `sampleWeights` is single-dimensional
with same number of samples as the `modelOutput`.
It represents a per-sample weighting when aggregating for Recall calculation.
name: MlRecallMetric
